Use the bricks:

Create a messaging arm to help Milo the Science Rover communicate his discovery.

Turn on the Smarthub and connect it to your device. Watch the video if you need help. 

See the Help panel for more guidance.

• Create and program Milo's messaging arm using the Tilt Sensor.
• Document Milo's communication with the base.
